title: Shared signed-total tensor functor
statement: For a preadditive monoidal category C with countable colimits and additive tensor products, construct a shared functor for the existing uncurried raw signed total tensor on cochain complexes. Its data are exactly the existing raw total construction.

source.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4; signed total tensor and localization tensorators

proof.text: Define the functor to be uncurry.obj applied to the existing curried tensor map₂HomologicalComplex for the three upward integer complex shapes. All data are explicit existing constructions.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YN and 07A4; signed total tensor and localization tensorators
